in_hebrew.name: Thayne
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Thayne הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Old English ‘thah’, meaning ‘people’ or ‘settlement’, and ‘ingas’, meaning ‘people of’ or ‘associated with’. Thayne signifies a farmstead or a settlement of people.

in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Farmstead, settlement
